key_insight: This framework turns deep learning attention maps into patient-specific, interpretable radiomic signatures for tumor classification.
clinical_relevance: It could help clinicians derive non-invasive imaging biomarkers that improve tumor characterization while offering clearer biological insight than whole-tumor models.
method: Segment tumors with a robust deep learning model.
Use Grad-CAM to find diagnostically important regions and apply adaptive thresholding for patient-specific signature extraction.
Validate signatures with deep learning classifiers and SHAP-interpreted radiomic models.
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated on BUSI breast ultrasound, KiTS renal CT, BraTS brain tumor, and a private UF Health renal CT cohort, with better discriminative performance than conventional whole-tumor radiomics.
watch_item: Clinical use may depend on consistent segmentation, threshold selection, and external validation across diverse scanners and patient populations.
paper_title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Discovery and Clinical Validation of Deep Radiomic Signatures in Tumor Classification
